en.topic_title: Hong Kong press group urges authorities to scrap new rules tightening media access to land records
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong press group has urged the government to scrap new rules tightening media access to the city’s land records, warning that the arrangements will “exacerbate information asymmetry” and harm freedom of information.



Hong Kong Land Registry’s online search services. Photo: Screenshot.



The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) called on authorities on Wednesday to shelve amendments to land registration regulations that could restrict media access to land records – a pub
